prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet expanding reference character thorn_bloom_mote; keep EXACT original silhouette identity, anatomy, colors, ink outlines and hand-painted 2D style: dusty pink rose petal insect, golden pollen head, pale petal wings, green thorns and fine hooked legs. Reference image shows existing poses, use it to preserve design. Transparent background true alpha. No labels, grid, text, background. Create SEVEN separate horizontal strips with large vertical gutters, exactly these counts LEFT TO RIGHT: strip1 FOUR idle breathing poses; strip2 EIGHT walk/flight cycle poses; strip3 FOUR windup anticipation poses; strip4 SIX attack poses; strip5 SIX recover-to-ready poses; strip6 FOUR hurt recoil poses; strip7 FOUR death poses from stagger to collapse and settled. 36 separate sprites total. Strips have differing counts intentionally. Within each strip positions evenly spaced with generous empty gutters. Sprite height at most 70% of strip height, width at most 65% of the narrowest 8-pose strip cell. Same scale for ALL sprites in all strips. All living poses face RIGHT orthographic side-view. Entire limbs, antennae, weapons/wings fit inside own space and do not overlap neighboring poses or strips. petal wings beat with real hinge changes; thrusts thorn spear-like forelimb right. Pose progression is articulated, meaningful joint changes and cloth/wing follow-through, never simple stamped copies shifted/rotated. Fixed foot/hover baseline within each strip.

qa.method: Visual semantic review, connected alpha components, explicit full-pose rectangles, >24 alpha edge checks; rejected touching-neighbor poses excluded
qa.runtime_visual_review: Reviewed actual motion_manifest output contact sheet for every animation: full body, weapons, antennae/wings present; no neighboring sprite fragments; unified source scale and stable foot/hover baseline.
qa.horizontal_registration: Explicit authored strip/cell body origins; central strips and variable row counts measured independently. Anchor does not follow weapon or wing bounding-box expansion. Natural pose lean/lunge relative to fixed origin preserved; flying roles do not use feet.
qa.anchor_review: All runtime entries specify anchor_x. Reviewed final rendered sequences with fixed vertical body-origin guide; no bounding-box weapon/wing recentering. Flight origins follow authored body/cell layout, not feet.

combat_motion_v7.calibration: Continuous endpoint height and rig median; uniform sheet palette match; source pixels never morphed or interpolated.
